sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Do not freeze: the COMPLETE contract still declares span as an operand, but the query only extracts it to impose FILTER(?span = ?stringerSpan) and then calculates with stringerSpan. This repeats the previously rejected unsupported equality and does not establish a verified semantic relationship or use span as a formula operand. Resolve the declared span/stringerSpan relationship and use the contractually correct operand consistently, or revise the contract if span is not required.
